title: Repository Truth Validation Before Any Engine Change
executive_summary: Phase99 zero-filled features are REAL on the current live/research inference path for bars after 2026-06-29, because dataset_v2 is stale and build_unified_frame fillna(0) masks merge misses. This is NOT research-only instrumentation. However, 22J overstated a single fillna root cause: (1) Dataset A includes 61% of bars outside dataset_v2 coverage, (2) structure_distance is 98.7% zero in dataset_v2 even when merge succeeds, (3) live ema50_slope/candle_direction are computed but unused by phase9_9. PipelineCache and build_unified_frame match 100%. Do not implement 22J-005 until dataset_v2 refresh and research window segmentation are complete.

1_real_production_bug.answer: Partially yes — stale dataset_v2 + fillna(0) on merge miss causes guaranteed phase99 zeros on all bars after 2026-06-29 on BOTH live and backtest paths today.

2_if_yes_where_introduced.answer: Primary introduction point: build_unified_frame left-merge on dataset_v2 timestamp followed by fillna(0.0) for phase99_* columns (unified_features.py:45-48), fed by PipelineCache.get_unified_frame loading DatasetStore.load_v2 without freshness check (pipeline_cache.py:107-108). Secondary: dataset_v2 not rebuilt since 2026-06-29.

3_if_no_what_false_diagnosis.answer: 22J implied a universal fillna merge defect causing zeros during RANGE scoring without separating (a) post-build candle window, (b) native structure_distance sparsity in training data, (c) unused live-computed alternatives. Research runners 22F/22J share production path — not a false profiler bug.

4_is_22j_005_justified.answer: Not yet. Refreshing/rebuilding dataset_v2 is lower-risk and addresses merge-miss zeros for ema50_slope and candle_direction. FeatureBuilder overlay (22J-005) would still leave structure_distance ~98% sparse and changes inference semantics without validated PF lift.

5_safe_to_modify_production.reason: Root cause is mixed; research Dataset A confounds staleness with engine behavior; no validated backtest improvement; structure_distance sparsity is training-native.

root_cause: D — Mixed issue (stale dataset_v2 + architectural dataset-merge inference + native structure_distance sparsity + Dataset A window amplification)
verdict_rationale: Segment research metrics by dataset_v2 coverage before engine proposals
Rebuild or extend dataset_v2 and measure merge_hit recovery before code changes
Fix research validation to use per-bar engine profiler instead of broken PF/hold_chain emission comparisons
Re-evaluate engine fix only after stale-data baseline is established
recommended_sequence: 1. Rebuild dataset_v2 through production build pipeline (phase9_production_build / ProductionDatasetV2Builder) — operational, not engine code change
2. Update phase22 research runners with dataset coverage guards and pre/post max_ts forensics
3. Re-run 22J forensics on in-coverage window only
4. Only then assess whether FeatureBuilder overlay (22J-005) adds value beyond dataset refresh
